text:
anna: Quick RFC follow-up re: sensorized rollout + handoff negotiation for canaries. Link to RFC: https://go/redwood/rfc/sensorized-rollouts. TL;DR: introduce observer quorum and a 'handover score' to decide safe cutover. Thoughts?

mike: :eyes: Love the observer quorum idea. Concern: extra latency on the critical path if we wait for observers.

jorge: We shouldn't block the request path. Probes should feed a scoring pipeline off the critical path. Gate on cached last-known score with a decay TTL.

lina: Agree. Also need idempotent handoff so retries are safe. Suggest adding handoff_token + sequence_number in the control-plane handshake.

anna: Proposed control-plane handshake payload (informal):
```
POST /rollout/handshake
{
  "candidate": "v2",
  "handoff_token": "abc123",
  "observations": [{"observer":"obs-a","score":0.98}, ...]
}
```
Responder returns `{"accept": true, "lease_seconds": 60}` or `{"accept": false, "reason": "quorum_missing"}`.

mike: Runtime note: when candidate accepts, we need soft-affinity for in-flight sessions to avoid mixed-model responses. Drain per-session KV cache for a small `handover_grace_ms` window.

jorge: We already have session-lease TTL. Extend to support `handover_grace_ms` and a drain marker on the session record. Default 200ms seems reasonable.

lina: Telemetry additions: `rollout.handover.score.p95`, `rollout.handover.quorum_lag.p99`, and `rollout.handover.accept_rate`. Dash should show recent observer versions.

sre-bot: ALERT if `rollout.handover.quorum_lag.p99` > 500ms for > 2m :rotating_light: 

anna: Tradeoffs we discussed: more observers => safer signal but higher decision latency. Proposed quorum formula: `quorum = min(ceil(0.6 * N), 3)`. Allow expedited acceptance if `score >= 0.995` to reduce latency for very high-confidence scenarios.

mike: Fallback policy: if handover fails after `N` attempts, auto-rollback to last stable variant. Use exponential backoff with jitter and a cooldown circuit-breaker to prevent oscillation.

jorge: Ownership question: who owns fallback policy config? Control-plane should own policy (exposed via rollout config); runtime enforces the decision. This keeps policies centrally auditable.

lina: Ops runbook items: (1) how to force a handoff-retry, (2) how to promote candidate manually, (3) how to pin a tenant to stable variant. Add CLI helper: `rw rollout force-handoff v2 --override`.

mike: Small runtime implementation note: on accept, mark `session.handoff_seq = seq` and add `handover_marker` TTL. Reads check marker to prefer candidate while marker present, otherwise fallback.

lina: Small nit: ensure we record observer binary/model versions along with score to avoid mixing signals from rolled observers.

anna: Action items: 1) Mike to prototype soft-affinity drain + `handover_grace_ms` (ETA 3d). 2) Jorge to add handshake API + token/seq model + idempotency (ETA 5d). 3) Lina to add metrics + alert config + dash changes (ETA 2d). 4) SRE to add alert thresholds to oncall playbook. I'll update RFC with these decisions and add the state-machine diagram.

mike: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled for canary: v2 -> 10% at 2026-03-25T15:00Z

lina: Also: during the prototype, verify that observer sampling rate (default 1%) yields stable scores for small traffic tenants; we might need adaptive sampling.

anna: Thanks all — I'll paste the updated state-machine diagram into the RFC and tag you for review.
